node.title: Full-fiber endpoints for finite minimum envelopes
node.statement: For integers4<=r<=E<=D, an actual rank-r nonzero polynomial evaluation space of degree<K on D+K points satisfies the spike/equal-fiber endpoint lower bound whenever the finite minimum F of smooth branches bounds every integer-degree child and each branch satisfies F_i'>=0,F_i''>=0,2F_i'>=E F_i'',2(r-2)F_i'>=(D+E)F_i'' on[r-1,E]. Weighted branch minima and all mixed branch pairs are concave. The envelope itself need not be convex or differentiable; individual branches need not bound children. No Jensen-on-the-minimum step or fractional-degree source is asserted.
